pairs.evidence: apps/console/src/ui/ui.test.tsx:293 A structural pin uses a needle that prose can write: a comment containing `counts: "given"` satisfies it even if the code no longer passes that prop. The negative pin two lines above (`/\bcount\b\s*[:,}]/` over seven hardcoded page files) also matches comments, so a doc edit can turn the suite red.

techniques.evidence: apps/console/src/ui/ui.test.tsx:293 Positive pin with a prose-spellable needle fails toward green. The sibling negative pin at :291 over-matches comments, and its population is a hand-kept list of 7 files.
apps/console/src/ui/drawer.test.tsx:69 The drawer's exit cutoff is proved on a fake clock at DRAWER_EXIT_MS-1 and then +1, not with a wall-time bound.
apps/console/src/ui/ui.test.tsx:239 The given counts (412/400/12) cannot come from the 5 local rows, so the asserted value names its producer (the daemon's totals) even after a query change.

pairs.subject: test-harness
pairs.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:162 No vitest config sets coverage.include, and vitest 5.0.5 defaults to 'only files covered by tests are included'. The JS ratchet's denominator is therefore the set of files a test already imports, so a new untested file or directory never appears and cannot lower the ratchet.

techniques.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:162 Same for stage, contract, stage-kit and tokens (lines 164-170). Only packages/contract/vitest.config.ts has a coverage block, and it sets exclude but no include.
.github/workflows/ci.yml:78 The cargo lane declares a floor on tests selected, so a lane that selects zero tests fails instead of passing.
.github/workflows/ci.yml:147 The lane set is derived from the workspace and every gate script must be scheduled. Jobs are separated by machine and timeout.
.github/workflows/ci.yml:84 The detached second Cargo workspace (the Tauri shell) is gated explicitly with its own test floor.
pnpm-workspace.yaml:12 The worktree junction quirk that made the JS gate check nothing is absorbed once in config, with its incident story kept in lines 6-11.
.github/workflows/ci.yml:2 CI inherits no local stores, secrets or live engine (lines 8-10).
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/config.rs:513 The shipped example config is asserted by running the daemon's own TOML reader over it, not by checking its text.

pairs.registryProposal: gate-scope-is-not-report-scope could name the tool default explicitly: vitest ≥4 with no coverage.include reports only test-loaded files, so the report-scope failure happens with no include list written at all.
